title: Replacing a Locked Gift Cards & Store Credit Card
content:
The replacement of a locked Gift Cards & Store Credit card is a new instrument of the locked card's replacement type, keeping the original expiry rules, loaded with the replacement value. The replacement transfer-out entry on the old card's ledger names the replacement as counterpart, that is, as the card that took over the value; the old card closes with reason replaced once nothing is left on it, and the investigation hold stays frozen on the old card until the theft review releases it.

## Business effect

| Record | After the replacement is issued |
|---|---|
| New card | Active, of the replacement type, holder's own, carrying the original expiry rules and an opening load of the replacement value |
| Old (locked) card's ledger | A replacement transfer-out entry for the replacement value, naming the new card as counterpart |
| Old card's status | Closed, reason replaced, when nothing is left on it; otherwise still locked, holding the remaining value (the investigation hold) until the theft review releases it |

## Action: `issue_card_replacement_8a64787f`

**Capability.** Issues a replacement for one of the holder's locked stored-value cards. One call creates a new, active instrument of the replacement type for the holder, loaded with the replacement value given, books the transfer of that value out of the locked card (naming the new card as the receiving instrument) and lowers the locked card's balance by it; the locked card is closed as replaced when nothing is left on it, and otherwise stays locked holding the remaining value. Afterwards the new card, its opening load and the locked card's transfer entry are visible on the account.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side action: unlock `issue_card_replacement_8a64787f`, then call it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `instrument_id` | The reference number of the locked card being replaced, as shown by the stored-value instrument lookup | Id |
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the holder who receives the replacement, as shown by the customer lookup | Id |
| `replacement_variant` | The instrument type issued as the replacement | Exactly one of the six instrument type names below |
| `replacement_usd` | The value loaded onto the replacement | A positive amount in USD with 2 decimal places, for example 85.20 |

Values of `replacement_variant`:

| Value | Use with this action |
|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | When the locked card's type names the e-Gift Card as its replacement type (plastic and electronic gift cards) |
| Return Store Credit | When the locked card is a Return Store Credit |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | A plastic gift card type that no card names as its replacement type; never issued by this action |
| Marlowe Rewards Note | A loyalty reward type that is never replaced; never issued by this action |
| Bonus Gift Card | A promotional type that is never replaced; never issued by this action |
| Goodwill Credit | A service-recovery type that is never replaced; never issued by this action |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new replacement card reference, its type, the last four digits of its card number, the value loaded in USD with 2 decimal places, the transfer entry reference on the locked card, and the locked card's remaining balance in USD with 2 decimal places with its status (closed when nothing remains, otherwise locked). The presence of the new card reference means the replacement was issued.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

For a locked plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card holding 70.00, a call with replacement type Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card and 52.00 creates an active e-Gift Card loaded with 52.00 and books a 52.00 transfer-out entry on the old card naming the new card; the old card stays locked holding 18.00.
